Let \(q=m/d\). The extension \(\mathbb C((t))/\mathbb C((t^m))\) has Galois group \(\mu_m\), acting by
\[
t\mapsto \zeta t,\qquad \zeta^m=1.
\]
Thus the conjugates of
\[
y=t^n+t^p
\]
are
\[
y_\zeta=\zeta^n t^n+\zeta^p t^p,\qquad \zeta\in\mu_m.
\]

The stabilizer of \(y\) is trivial: if \(y_\zeta=y\), then comparing the distinct \(t^n\) and \(t^p\) coefficients gives \(\zeta^n=\zeta^p=1\). Hence \(\zeta^{\gcd(m,n,p)}=1\). But \(\gcd(m,n)=d\) and \(\gcd(d,p)=1\), so \(\gcd(m,n,p)=1\). Therefore the minimal polynomial has degree \(m\), and
\[
\operatorname{Disc}_Y P=\prod_{\{\zeta,\eta\}\subset \mu_m,\ \zeta\ne\eta}
(y_\zeta-y_\eta)^2.
\]

Now
\[
y_\zeta-y_\eta=(\zeta^n-\eta^n)t^n+(\zeta^p-\eta^p)t^p.
\]
If \(\zeta^n\ne\eta^n\), the leading term has order \(n\). If \(\zeta^n=\eta^n\), then the leading term has order \(p\).

The map \(\mu_m\to\mu_q\), \(\zeta\mapsto \zeta^n\), has fibers of size \(d\). Therefore the number of pairs with equal \(n\)-power is
\[
q\binom d2=\frac{m(d-1)}2,
\]
and the number with unequal \(n\)-power is
\[
\binom m2-\frac{m(d-1)}2=\frac{m(m-d)}2.
\]
So the lowest \(t\)-order in the discriminant is
\[
2\left(n\frac{m(m-d)}2+p\frac{m(d-1)}2\right)
=m\bigl(n(m-d)+p(d-1)\bigr).
\]
Since \(X=t^m\), the lowest \(X\)-degree is
\[
n(m-d)+p(d-1).
\]

It remains to compute the coefficient. For pairs in distinct fibers, the leading coefficients contribute
\[
\left(\prod_{\alpha<\beta,\ \alpha,\beta\in\mu_q}(\alpha-\beta)^2\right)^{d^2}
=
\left((-1)^{(q-1)(q-2)/2}q^q\right)^{d^2}.
\]
For pairs inside one fiber, since \(\gcd(p,d)=1\), the \(p\)-th power permutes the kernel \(\mu_d\). Across all \(q\) fibers this contributes
\[
(-1)^{p(d-1)(q-1)}
\left((-1)^{(d-1)(d-2)/2}d^d\right)^q.
\]
Multiplying these gives the leading coefficient
\[
(-1)^S d^m q^{md},
\]
where
\[
S=
d^2\frac{(q-1)(q-2)}2
+q\frac{(d-1)(d-2)}2
+p(d-1)(q-1).
\]

Therefore, with \(q=m/d\), the lowest-degree nonzero term is
\[
\boxed{
(-1)^S d^m q^{md}X^{\,n(m-d)+p(d-1)}
}
\]
with
\[
S=
d^2\frac{(q-1)(q-2)}2
+q\frac{(d-1)(d-2)}2
+p(d-1)(q-1).
\]
